import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
from torchrec.dlrm import DLRM
from torchrec.dataloader import DataLoader
from torchrec.datasets.random import RandomRecDataset
from torchrec.optim.fused import fuse_embedding_optimizer
from torchrec.distributed.model_parallel import DistributedModelParallel
from torchrec.distributed.train_pipeline import TrainPipeline
from torchrec.distributed.train_pipeline import TrainPipelineContext
from torchrec.distributed.train_pipeline import train_one_epoch
from torchrec.distributed.train_pipeline import PrefetchTrainPipelineContext

def _get_random_dataloader(num_embeddings: int, batch_size: int, pin_memory: bool) -> DataLoader:
    dataset = RandomRecDataset(
        num_embeddings=num_embeddings,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        num_dense=13,
        num_sparse=26,
        num_batches=1000,
    )
    dataloader = DataLoader(
        dataset,
        batch_size=None,
        pin_memory=pin_memory,
    )
    return dataloader

def train(
    num_embeddings: int,
    embedding_dim: int,
    dense_arch_layer_sizes: list,
    over_arch_layer_sizes: list,
    learning_rate: float,
):
    dist.init_process_group(backend="nccl")
    rank = dist.get_rank()
    world_size = dist.get_world_size()
    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    model = DLRM(
        embedding_bag_collection=None,  # You may need to construct this properly
        dense_arch_layer_sizes=dense_arch_layer_sizes,
        over_arch_layer_sizes=over_arch_layer_sizes,
        embedding_dim=embedding_dim,
        num_embeddings=num_embeddings,
        num_dense=13,
        num_sparse=26,
    ).to(device)

    optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)
    fuse_embedding_optimizer(model, optimizer)

    model = DistributedModelParallel(
        module=model,
        device=device,
        process_group=dist.group.WORLD,
        env=None,
        init_data_parallel=True,
        gradient_as_bucket_view=True,
        overlap_communication=True,
    )

    dataloader = _get_random_dataloader(num_embeddings, batch_size=1024, pin_memory=True)

    train_pipeline = TrainPipeline(
        model=model,
        optimizer=optimizer,
        dataloader=dataloader,
        device=device,
        context_class=PrefetchTrainPipelineContext,
    )

    for epoch in range(1):
        train_one_epoch(train_pipeline, epoch=epoch)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    train(
        num_embeddings=10000,
        embedding_dim=64,
        dense_arch_layer_sizes=[512, 256, 128],
        over_arch_layer_sizes=[1024, 1024, 512, 256, 1],
        learning_rate=0.01,
    )
